caption: The drawing depicts a single large bell suspended within a rectangular metal frame. The bell is colored gold with shading to indicate its cylindrical, flared shape and metallic surface. The metal frame, rendered in shades of gray, features curved and ornamental elements at the top and sides, with bolts securing the structure at its base. At the upper right, there is a handlebar, similarly gray, positioned horizontally with a wooden grip colored in light brown. The frame is anchored to a rectangular wooden platform, illustrated in brown with visible wood grain and horizontal board lines. The overall composition is centered, presenting the entire bell assembly clearly against a light, neutral background.
title: Portable Brass Hand Bell
